name: FreelanceHub API
description:
REST API for **FreelanceHub** – a freelance marketplace platform.
This API covers the full **Client → Job Post** workflow as modelled in the
FreelanceHub UI, including authentication, dashboard statistics, multi-step
job creation (title/category/description → skills/experience → budget/timeline),
review, publishing, and proposal management.

## Auth
All protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT token obtained from `POST /auth/login`.

## Job-post lifecycle
```
draft (POST /jobs)
  │
  ├─ patch fields (PATCH /jobs/{jobId})
  │
  └─ publish (POST /jobs/{jobId}/publish)
        │
        └─ active  ──►  closed
```
